questions.stem: In the xy-plane, points A(6, 0) and B(0, 6) lie on the circle x² + y² = 36. What is the length of the minor arc AB ?

questions.subskill: Area of a trapezoid
questions.stem: A trapezoid has parallel sides of lengths 7 centimeters and 13 centimeters, and the distance between the parallel sides is 5 centimeters. What is the area of the trapezoid, in square centimeters?

questions.subskill: Finding a constant from the sum of a line's intercepts
questions.stem: In the xy-plane, the graph of 3x − 5y = k, where k is a positive constant, has an x-intercept and a y-intercept whose sum is 8. What is the value of k ?

questions.subskill: Greatest whole number under a budget with a minimum purchase
questions.stem: Kim has $20 to spend on pens, which cost $1.25 each, and notebooks, which cost $3.50 each. She must buy at least 4 notebooks. What is the greatest number of pens she can buy?

questions.subskill: Point with related coordinates on a line
questions.stem: In the xy-plane, the point (a, a + 3) lies on the line 2x + 5y = 29. What is the value of a ?

questions.subskill: Solving an equation with two square roots
questions.stem: What value of x satisfies the equation √(x + 9) − √x = 1 ?

questions.subskill: Time for a falling object to reach a height
questions.stem: An object is dropped from a height of 80 meters. Its height above the ground t seconds after it is dropped is h(t) = 80 − 5t² meters. How many seconds after it is dropped does the object reach the ground?

questions.subskill: Comparing exponential, polynomial and linear values
questions.stem: Which of the following functions has the greatest value at x = 10 ?

questions.subskill: Percent change in area from changes in two dimensions
questions.stem: The length of a rectangle is increased by 20%, and its width is decreased by 10%. Which of the following describes the change in the area of the rectangle?

questions.subskill: Cosine of an angle in the coordinate plane
questions.stem: In the xy-plane, triangle OPQ has vertices O(0, 0), P(8, 0) and Q(8, 6). What is the value of cos(∠POQ) ?

questions.subskill: Radius from an arc length and a radian angle
questions.stem: In a circle, a central angle of 2.5 radians intercepts an arc of length 15 centimeters. What is the radius of the circle, in centimeters?

questions.subskill: Volume of a rectangular box
questions.stem: A rectangular box measures 3 inches by 5 inches by 8 inches. What is the volume of the box, in cubic inches?

questions.subskill: Slope from a point and an x-intercept
questions.stem: In the xy-plane, a line with slope m passes through the point (2, −1) and crosses the x-axis at x = 6. What is the value of m ?

questions.subskill: Sum of zeros from two values of a factored quadratic
questions.stem: The function p is defined by p(x) = (x − a)(x − b), where a and b are constants. If p(0) = 12 and p(1) = 6, what is the value of a + b ?

questions.subskill: Simplifying a product of conjugates plus a constant
questions.stem: Which of the following is equivalent to (x + 5)(x − 5) + 25 ?

questions.subskill: Minimum of a horizontally shifted quadratic
questions.stem: The function f is defined by f(x) = x² − 4x + 7, and g(x) = f(x + 3). Which of the following gives the minimum value of g and the value of x at which it occurs?

questions.subskill: Effect of sample size on the margin of error
questions.stem: A polling organization surveyed a random sample of 400 voters and reported a margin of error of 5 percentage points. Suppose it had instead surveyed a random sample of 1,600 voters chosen in the same way. Which of the following is most likely true about the margin of error for the larger sample?

choices.A: It would be larger than 5 percentage points.
choices.B: It would be exactly 5 percentage points.
choices.C: It would be exactly 20 percentage points.
choices.D: It would be smaller than 5 percentage points.

questions.subskill: Fuel remaining after a trip
questions.stem: A car's 14-gallon fuel tank is full. The car uses 1 gallon of fuel for every 32 miles it travels. How many gallons of fuel remain in the tank after the car travels 200 miles?

questions.subskill: Part from a part-to-part ratio and a difference
questions.stem: At a school, the ratio of the number of students who walk to school to the number who ride the bus is 2 to 3. There are 12 more students who ride the bus than students who walk. How many students walk to school?

questions.subskill: Exterior angle of a triangle
questions.stem: In triangle ABC, the exterior angle at vertex C measures 115°, and the measure of angle A is 48°. What is the measure of angle B ?

questions.subskill: Comparing volumes of a sphere and a cylinder
questions.stem: A sphere and a right circular cylinder each have a radius of 3 centimeters, and the cylinder is 4 centimeters tall. The volume of the sphere is k times the volume of the cylinder. What is the value of k ?

questions.subskill: Share of revenue from a subgroup
questions.stem: At a store, 40% of the customers are members and the rest are nonmembers. On average, a member spends $60 per visit and a nonmember spends $40 per visit. Assuming each customer makes one visit, what percent of the store's revenue comes from members? (Disregard the % sign when entering your answer.)

questions.subskill: Coefficients from the vertex of a parabola
questions.stem: The function f is defined by f(x) = ax² + 4x + c, where a and c are constants. The vertex of the graph of y = f(x) in the xy-plane is (−1, 3). What is the value of a + c ?

questions.subskill: Value of a completed square from an equation
questions.stem: If x² + 6x = 7, what is the value of (x + 3)² ?

questions.subskill: Slope of a line through a given intersection point
questions.stem: In the xy-plane, the line y = mx + 2, where m is a constant, intersects the line y = 3x − 4 at a point whose x-coordinate is 2. What is the value of m ?

questions.subskill: Square with a perimeter equal to a circle's circumference
questions.stem: A circle has an area of 49π square centimeters. A square has a perimeter equal to the circumference of the circle. What is the side length of the square, in centimeters?

questions.subskill: Evaluating a linear function at a related input
questions.stem: The function f is defined by f(x) = −3x + 12. If f(k) = 0, what is the value of f(2k) ?

questions.subskill: Substituting into a linear relationship
questions.stem: If y = 3x and x = 7, what is the value of 2y ?

questions.subskill: Distributing a monomial over a binomial
questions.stem: Which of the following is equivalent to 2x(3x − 4) ?

questions.subskill: y-intercept from an x-intercept and another point
questions.stem: In the xy-plane, a line has an x-intercept of 4 and passes through the point (6, 5). What is the y-intercept of the line?

questions.subskill: Segment of the hypotenuse cut by the altitude
questions.stem: A right triangle has legs of lengths 9 and 12. The altitude drawn from the right angle to the hypotenuse divides the hypotenuse into two segments. What is the length of the shorter segment?

questions.subskill: Where two linear functions given by tables are equal
questions.stem:
The table below shows three values of each of the linear functions f and g.
x | 0 | 2 | 4
f(x) | 3 | 7 | 11
g(x) | 15 | 11 | 7
For what value of x is f(x) = g(x) ?

questions.subskill: Slope of a line through the origin meeting a line where x = y
questions.stem: In the xy-plane, the line y = kx, where k is a constant, intersects the line 3x + 2y = 12 at a point whose x-coordinate and y-coordinate are equal. What is the value of k ?

questions.subskill: When two linear quantities are equal
questions.stem: A phone's battery is at 85% and drops by 12 percentage points each hour while in use. A second phone is at 40% and gains 18 percentage points each hour while charging. After how many hours will the two phones have the same battery level?

questions.subskill: Zero of an exponential function
questions.stem: The function h is defined by h(x) = 2ˣ − 8. What is the zero of h ?

questions.subskill: Solving a factorable quadratic equation
questions.stem: Which of the following is a solution to the equation x² − 5x − 14 = 0 ?

questions.subskill: Comparing successive percent changes in different orders
questions.stem: Store A raises the price of a jacket by 10% and later lowers the new price by 10%. Store B, which starts with the same price, lowers it by 10% and later raises the new price by 10%. Which statement about the final prices is true?

choices.A: Store A's final price is higher.
choices.B: Store B's final price is higher.
choices.D: It depends on the original price.

questions.subskill: Unknown count from a without-replacement probability
questions.stem: A jar holds 3 red tokens and an unknown number of blue tokens. Two tokens are taken from the jar at random at the same time. The probability that both tokens are red is 1/12. How many blue tokens are in the jar?

questions.subskill: Center of a circle from a point and its radius
questions.stem: In the xy-plane, a circle has its center at (a, a), where a > 0, and a radius of 4√2. The circle passes through the origin. What is the value of a ?

questions.subskill: Area of a right triangle with legs in a 2 : 1 ratio
questions.stem: In right triangle ABC, the right angle is at A, AB = 2 · AC, and BC = 10. What is the area of the triangle?

questions.subskill: Solving a two-step linear equation with a fraction
questions.stem: What value of x satisfies the equation x/5 + 2 = 6 ?

questions.subskill: Intersections of a line and an absolute value graph
questions.stem: In the xy-plane, at how many points does the graph of y = −x + 7 intersect the graph of y = |x − 1| ?

questions.subskill: Factored form of a quadratic given in vertex form
questions.stem: Which of the following is equivalent to y = 3(x − 2)² − 12 ?

questions.subskill: Sum of solutions of an equation with variable denominators
questions.stem: For x ≠ 0, what is the sum of all solutions to the equation 3/x + 4/x² = 1 ?

questions.subskill: Difference of two function values
questions.stem: The function f is defined by f(x) = 3x². What is the value of f(2) − f(1) ?

questions.subskill: Comparing the mean and median after adding a value
questions.stem: The test scores of five students are 70, 75, 80, 85 and 90. A sixth student scores 100. Which statement about the six scores is true?

choices.A: The mean is greater than the median.
choices.B: The median is greater than the mean.
choices.C: The mean and the median are equal.
choices.D: There is not enough information to compare them.

questions.subskill: Radius from the area between concentric circles
questions.stem: Two circles have the same center. The smaller circle has radius r and the larger circle has radius 2r. The area of the region inside the larger circle but outside the smaller circle is 27π. What is the value of r ?

questions.subskill: Hypotenuse when it exceeds a leg by a given amount
questions.stem: In a right triangle, the hypotenuse is 2 units longer than one of the legs, and the other leg has length 6. What is the length of the hypotenuse?

questions.subskill: Point on a proportional line with a coordinate condition
questions.stem: In the xy-plane, a line passes through the origin and has a slope of 4/3. The point (p, q) lies on the line, and q − p = 5. What is the value of p ?

questions.subskill: Condition on a slope for an intersection with a negative x-coordinate
questions.stem: In the xy-plane, the lines y = 2x − 5 and y = ax + 7, where a is a constant, intersect at a point whose x-coordinate is negative. Which of the following could be the value of a ?

questions.subskill: Evaluating a linear function after finding its intercept
questions.stem: The function f is defined by f(x) = (2/3)x + b, where b is a constant. If f(9) = 1, what is the value of f(−3) ?

questions.subskill: Linear equation from a ratio of quantities sold
questions.stem: A coffee shop sells small cups of coffee for $3 each and large cups for $5 each. On Monday it sold 3 times as many small cups as large cups and collected a total of $364 from these sales. How many large cups did it sell on Monday?

questions.subskill: Substituting into a linear model of coins
questions.stem: The equation 0.25x + 0.10y = 4.70 represents a collection of x quarters and y dimes worth $4.70 in all. If the collection contains 12 quarters, how many dimes does it contain?

questions.subskill: Returning to an initial height in a quadratic model
questions.stem: A ball is thrown upward from a platform. Its height above the ground, in meters, t seconds after it is thrown is modeled by h(t) = −2(t − 3)² + 50. How many seconds after it is thrown does the ball return to the height from which it was thrown?

questions.subskill: A number from the sum with its reciprocal
questions.stem: A number x is greater than 1, and the sum of x and its reciprocal is 10/3. What is the value of x ?

questions.subskill: Annual percent growth from two values two years apart
questions.stem: A town's population was 1,200 in 2020 and 1,452 in 2022. The population increased by the same percent each year. By what percent did the population increase each year? (Disregard the % sign when entering your answer.)

questions.subskill: Evaluating a related exponential expression
questions.stem: If 2^(3x) = 64, what is the value of 2ˣ ?

questions.subskill: Ratio applied after excluding a group
questions.stem: In a survey of 300 people, 40 said they prefer neither tea nor coffee. Among the rest, the ratio of people who prefer tea to people who prefer coffee is 2 : 3. How many of the people surveyed prefer tea?

questions.subskill: Recognising an equivalent equation
questions.stem: Which of the following equations has the same solution as 2(x − 4) = 10 ?

questions.subskill: Translating a comparison of fractional parts
questions.stem: Three-fourths of a number is 15 more than one-third of the same number. What is the number?

questions.subskill: x-intercept of a parallel line through a point
questions.stem: In the xy-plane, line ℓ passes through the point (0, −4) and is parallel to the line 3x − 6y = 7. What is the x-intercept of line ℓ ?

questions.subskill: Zeros of a vertically shifted quadratic
questions.stem: The function f is defined by f(x) = (x + 3)(x − 1), and g(x) = f(x) − 5. What are the zeros of g ?

questions.subskill: Constant term from the minimum value of a quadratic
questions.stem: The function f is defined by f(x) = x² + 4x + c, where c is a constant. The minimum value of f is 6. What is the value of c ?

questions.subskill: Squaring a product with a fractional exponent
questions.stem: For x > 0, which of the following is equivalent to (4x^(1/2))² ?

questions.subskill: Minimum of a sum of absolute values
questions.stem: For every real number x, let f(x) be the sum of the distance from x to 4 and the distance from x to −2 on the number line, so that f(x) = |x − 4| + |x + 2|. What is the least possible value of f(x) ?

questions.subskill: Length of the interval where a quadratic is positive
questions.stem: The function h is defined by h(x) = −x² + 8x − 12. The values of x for which h(x) > 0 form an interval. What is the length of that interval?

questions.subskill: Distance from a vertex of a square to a midpoint
questions.stem: Square ABCD has sides of length 10. Point E is the midpoint of side AB. What is the length of segment DE ?

questions.subskill: Writing one equation for three related lengths
questions.stem: A carpenter cuts a 20-foot board into three pieces. The second piece is twice as long as the first, and the third piece is 2 feet longer than the first. What is the length, in feet, of the longest piece?

questions.subskill: System of equations for time at two speeds
questions.stem: Hana runs at 6 miles per hour and walks at 3 miles per hour. On one outing she covers 15 miles in a total of 3.5 hours. How many hours does she spend running?

questions.subskill: Constant in a factored quadratic from a point
questions.stem: In the xy-plane, the graph of y = (x − 2)(x + k), where k is a constant, passes through the point (4, 12). What is the value of k ?

questions.subskill: Using a quadratic condition with a linear equation
questions.stem: If x² − 9 = 0, x + y = 5 and x < 0, what is the value of y ?

questions.subskill: Evaluating an exponential function at a fractional input
questions.stem: The function h is defined by h(x) = 4ˣ. What is the value of h(1.5) ?

questions.subskill: Width of a rectangle from a quadratic area
questions.stem: A rectangle has an area of x² + 7x + 12 square units and a length of x + 4 units, where x > 0. Which expression represents the width of the rectangle, in units?

questions.subskill: Square with the same perimeter as an equilateral triangle
questions.stem: An equilateral triangle has sides of length 8 centimeters. A square has the same perimeter as the triangle. What is the area of the square, in square centimeters?

questions.subskill: Area of a triangle formed by two radii and a chord
questions.stem: In a circle with center O and radius 5, chord AB has length 8. What is the area of triangle AOB ?

questions.subskill: Constant-rate projection to a limit
questions.stem: Jo's phone uses data at a constant rate. In the first 10 days of a month it used 2.5 gigabytes (GB). At this rate, on what day of the month will the phone reach its 6 GB limit?

questions.subskill: Linear model for depth below the surface
questions.stem: A diver starts at a depth of −20 feet (20 feet below the surface) and descends at a constant rate of 15 feet per minute. After how many minutes will the diver be at −110 feet?

questions.subskill: Equal earnings at two hourly rates
questions.stem: A plumber charges $45 per hour and an electrician charges $60 per hour. On one job, the plumber worked 2 hours longer than the electrician, and both earned the same amount. How many hours did the electrician work?

questions.subskill: Identifying an exponential function from a table
questions.stem:
The table shows four values of a function f.
x | 0 | 1 | 2 | 3
f(x) | 4 | 12 | 36 | 108
Which of the following could define f ?

questions.subskill: Value of a shifted exponential from a known power
questions.stem: If 3ᵃ = 7, what is the value of 3^(a + 2) ?

questions.subskill: Evaluating a cubic function at two inputs
questions.stem: The function f is defined by f(x) = x³ − 4x. What is the value of f(−2) + f(3) ?

questions.subskill: Solving a simple radical equation
questions.stem: If √(x + 7) = 4, what is the value of x ?

questions.subskill: Conclusion from a randomized experiment with volunteers
questions.stem: Researchers recruited 200 volunteers and randomly assigned each to follow either a new sleep routine or their usual routine for a month. Volunteers who followed the new routine had higher average test scores. Which conclusion is best supported?

choices.A: The new routine likely caused higher test scores for people similar to these volunteers.
choices.B: The new routine causes higher test scores for all students in the country.
choices.C: No conclusion about cause can be drawn because the volunteers were not randomly selected.
choices.D: Higher test scores caused volunteers to choose the new routine.

questions.subskill: Mean of two values from two overall means
questions.stem: The mean of the numbers a, b and c is 12. The mean of the numbers a, b, c, d and e is 15. What is the mean of d and e ?

questions.subskill: Area of an isosceles triangle with 30° base angles
questions.stem: An isosceles triangle has two sides of length 10, and the two angles opposite those sides each measure 30°. What is the area of the triangle?

questions.subskill: Coefficients of an equivalent linear expression
questions.stem: The equation 3(2x + 1) − 2(x − 4) = ax + b is true for all values of x, where a and b are constants. What is the value of a + b ?

questions.subskill: Finding a coordinate after finding the slope
questions.stem: In the xy-plane, the line y = kx + 3, where k is a constant, passes through the points (2, 11) and (−1, n). What is the value of n ?

questions.subskill: Input for a given output of a quadratic
questions.stem: The function f is defined by f(x) = x² − 2x − 8. For what value of x is f(x) = −9 ?

questions.subskill: Identifying a decreasing exponential function
questions.stem: Which of the following functions is decreasing for all values of x ?

questions.subskill: Tangent of an angle formed by a rectangle's diagonal
questions.stem: A rectangle is 12 units long and 5 units wide. A diagonal of the rectangle forms an acute angle θ with one of the longer sides. What is the value of tan θ ?

questions.subskill: Perimeter of a right triangle from a sine value and the hypotenuse
questions.stem: In a right triangle, one acute angle θ satisfies sin θ = 3/5, and the hypotenuse has length 20. What is the perimeter of the triangle?

questions.subskill: Maximum value from the range and the minimum
questions.stem: A data set has a range of 24, and its minimum value is 13. What is the maximum value of the data set?

questions.subskill: Price that maximizes a quadratic revenue model
questions.stem: A theater's revenue, in dollars, from ticket sales is modeled by R(p) = p(600 − 20p), where p is the ticket price in dollars. What ticket price gives the greatest revenue?

questions.subskill: Time to empty a tank with inflow and outflow
questions.stem: A tank holds 1,200 liters of water. Water drains out at 30 liters per minute while a pipe adds water at 12 liters per minute. To the nearest minute, how many minutes will it take for the tank to empty?

questions.subskill: Translating a verbal equation with grouping
questions.stem: Twice the sum of a number and 5 is 26. What is the number?

questions.subskill: Solving a factored quadratic set equal to a nonzero constant
questions.stem: What is the larger solution to the equation (x + 2)(x − 3) = 14 ?

questions.subskill: Interpreting the initial value of an exponential model
questions.stem: The value, in dollars, of a painting t years after it was purchased is modeled by V(t) = 3,000(1.05)ᵗ. What is the best interpretation of 3,000 in this context?

choices.A: The value increases by $3,000 each year.
choices.B: The value increases by 3,000% each year.
choices.C: The value one year after purchase is $3,000.
choices.D: The value at the time of purchase is $3,000.

questions.subskill: Solving an equation with two rational exponents
questions.stem: For a > 0, a^(1/2) = 2a^(1/4). What is the value of a ?

questions.subskill: Inverse variation in a work problem
questions.stem: Working at the same rate, 4 painters can paint a house in 9 days. At this rate, how many days would it take 6 painters to paint the house?

questions.subskill: Possible third side of a triangle
questions.stem: Two sides of a triangle have lengths 5 and 9. Which of the following could be the length of the third side?

questions.subskill: Where a circle tangent to the x-axis crosses the y-axis
questions.stem: In the xy-plane, a circle has its center at (4, 5) and is tangent to the x-axis. The circle intersects the y-axis at two points. What is the sum of the y-coordinates of these two points?

questions.subskill: Volume of a cone with a related radius
questions.stem: A right circular cone has a height of 12 centimeters, and the radius of its base is half its height. What is the volume of the cone, in cubic centimeters?

questions.subskill: Interpreting an intercept of a linear equation in context
questions.stem: Dana earns $15 per hour at job A and $9 per hour at job B. The equation 15x + 9y = 135 represents the numbers of hours x at job A and y at job B that Dana works to earn exactly $135. What is the best interpretation of the x-intercept of the graph of this equation in the xy-plane?

choices.A: Dana earns $9 per hour at job B.
choices.B: Dana earns $135 by working 9 hours at job A and no hours at job B.
choices.C: Dana earns $135 by working 9 hours at job B and no hours at job A.
choices.D: Dana earns $135 per hour when working both jobs.

questions.subskill: Writing a system of equations from a context
questions.stem: A school bought a total of 40 notebooks and pens. Each notebook cost $3.00 and each pen cost $1.50, and the school spent $87.00 in all. If n is the number of notebooks and p is the number of pens, which system of equations represents this situation?

questions.subskill: Product of the solutions with an unknown coefficient
questions.stem: In the equation 2x² + kx − 12 = 0, k is a constant, and the equation has two real solutions. What is the product of the solutions?

questions.subskill: Zeros of a quadratic in vertex form
questions.stem: The function f is defined by f(x) = −(x + 1)² + 9. What are the x-intercepts of the graph of y = f(x) in the xy-plane?

questions.subskill: Vertex after a horizontal and vertical shift

questions.subskill: Unknown exponents from two exponent rules
questions.stem: For x > 1, (xᵃ)(x³) = x¹² and (xᵃ)ᵇ = x¹⁸. What is the value of b ?

questions.subskill: Tangent of an angle from a point on a circle
questions.stem: In the xy-plane, point P lies on the circle x² + y² = 100 in Quadrant I, and the x-coordinate of P is 6. If O is the origin, what is the tangent of the angle that segment OP makes with the positive x-axis?
